_comment: Ceilings for the startup context budget, checked by scripts/context_budget.py --check (CI job lint). Policy: ceiling = observed value + ~5% headroom, so CI catches regressions without flagging noise. After a deliberate slimming, tighten to the new observed values + ~5%; raise a ceiling only together with the change that justifies the growth. Current values: python3 scripts/context_budget.py.
